description: Override one control's target maturity (write — ADMIN role): a level L0–L5 with a reason, or null to inherit its domain's target again (domain targets: scf_update_org_settings).

level.description: Target CMM level L0–L5 for this control; null clears the override (and its reason) and the control inherits its domain target

reason.description: Why this control departs from its domain target (max 2000 characters) — required when level is set

scf_id.description: SCF control identifier in DOMAIN-NN format — obtain from scf_list_scoped_controls

name: scf_set_target_maturity
